title: Revengeful
summary: REVENGEFUL, adjective revenj'ful. 1. full of revenge or a desire to inflict pain or evil for injury received; spiteful; malicious; wreaking revenge. If thy revengeful heart cannot forgive. 2. Vindicti

inlines.v: REVENGEFUL, adjective revenj'ful. 1. full of revenge or a desire to inflict pain or evil for injury received; spiteful; malicious; wreaking revenge. If thy revengeful heart cannot forgive. 2. Vindictive; inflicting punishment. May my hands never brandish more revengeful steel.
